rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; ABCD training data collected from 21 sites in the USA through multi-brand 3T scanners
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data from ABCD were collected from 21 sites in the USA through multi-brand 3T scanners."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development) dataset used for normative model training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training (n= 6,756), validation (n= 751), and testing (n= 3,524) purposes."

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABCD dataset used exclusively for normative model training; other datasets (ABIDE-II, ADHD-200, BHRCS) reserved for evaluation only
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training (n= 6,756), validation (n= 751), and testing (n= 3,524) purposes. ... The ABCD test set (n= 3,524) and the complete datasets of ABIDE-II (n= 580), ADHD-200 (n= 922), and BHRCS (n= 737) were reserved for the evaluation procedure (i.e., final tests)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase TD subjects from ABCD dataset; subjects with normal CBCL score (lower 3 quartiles) selected, then 90% reserved for training/validation, with 9/10 assigned to training
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training (n= 6,756), validation (n= 751), and testing (n= 3,524) purposes."

rci6_sex.detail: Sex breakdown for training subset (n=6,756) not separately reported; overall ABCD (N=11,031): Male 52.0%, Female 48.0%

rci7_age.detail: Age statistics for training subset (n=6,756) not separately reported; overall ABCD (N=11,031): mean 9.9 ± SD 0.6 years; subjects younger than 20 years selected; ABCD recruited children aged 9-10
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Age, y ± SD 9.9 ± 0.6" (Table 1, overall ABCD N=11,031); "we selected subjects younger than 20 years of age"
